title: Add two features to an existing class, with tests (JavaScript)
prompt:
Add two features to `TodoList` in src/todos.js:

1. `remove(id)` deletes the todo with that id and returns it. If there is no such todo it throws an Error whose message contains the id.
2. `list()` takes an optional filter: `list()` returns all todos as it does now, `list({ done: true })` returns only completed todos and `list({ done: false })` only open ones.

Add tests for both features to test/todos.test.mjs and keep the existing tests passing (`npm test`).
